inBoundaries: View list of employees (users with role EMPLEADO) belonging to the current business (negocio)
Create new employees specifying their email and an initial password for portal access
Edit existing employee details via a sheet overlay
View detailed employee profile on a dedicated page (empleados/:id) including financial metrics and operational history
View history of cash registers (cajas) operated by the employee
View summary of income (pagos/pedidos) and expenses (gastos) registered by the employee
outBoundaries: Employee self-service features (like employees editing their own profile from the employee portal)

userJourneys.description: The admin navigates to the 'Empleados' section in the sidebar. They see a table or list showing all registered employees for their business, with filters for active/inactive status and a search bar for names or emails.

The admin clicks 'Nuevo Empleado', a responsive sheet opens. The admin fills in name, email, password (so the employee can log in), base salary, and target weekly hours, then saves. The new employee is created and can log into the employee portal.
The admin clicks the 'Edit' action for an employee. A responsive sheet opens with the details pre-filled (excluding password). The admin updates the salary, hours, or name, and saves.

userJourneys.scenario: Admin views employee details and financial metrics
userJourneys.description: The admin clicks on an employee's name or a 'Ver detalles' action. They are navigated to a new subview route `empleados/:id`. This dedicated page displays the employee's operational metrics (e.g., total orders created, total income processed, and total expenses registered), and a section detailing the cash registers (cajas) they have opened and closed.
The admin clicks 'Desactivar' on an active employee. After confirmation, the employee's status changes to inactive and they can no longer log in.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The admin is logged in and navigates to /admin/empleados
acceptanceCriteria.then: A list of users with role 'EMPLEADO' for the current business is displayed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The admin is on the employees view
acceptanceCriteria.when: The admin submits the new employee form with valid data including a password
acceptanceCriteria.then: A new employee is created in the system and appears in the list.
It displays the employee's operational metrics and a list of their past 'Cajas'.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The admin clicks 'Edit' for an employee
acceptanceCriteria.when: The admin changes details in the sheet and saves
acceptanceCriteria.then: The employee data is updated successfully.

uxBehavior.layout: Standard admin layout for the list view (/admin/empleados). A dedicated sub-page for details (/admin/empleados/:id). Uses 'ResponsiveSheet' strictly for creation and editing actions.
uxBehavior.interactions: Navigational click to see details. Sheet opens for create/edit. Confirmations for destructive actions like deactivating an employee.
uxBehavior.aesthetics: Clean, professional, aligning with the existing UI, using modern typography, charts/cards for metrics, and clear data tables for cash register (cajas) history.

businessRules: An admin can only see and manage employees belonging to their own 'negocioId'.
Employee emails must be unique across the entire system.
New employees must have a password provided by the admin upon creation.
Financial metrics shown must strictly belong to actions performed by the employee (e.g., Cajas where usuarioId matches the employee, Pagos where registradoPorId matches).
